blurb: Guests can rent motorized boats for full-day use on Lake Champlain, play golf with various daily rates and social events, rent golf carts for use around the resort, and rent seasonal or overnight marina slips for their vessels. Boater safety certification is required for motorized boat operators born after 1/1/1974. The resort offers a variety of outdoor activities including bocce, yoga, and fitness center access.
